phalati.cp: phal + a. bears fruit; bursts open; splits.
phalati.p: [Phala+a+ti] (kri) Google Translate ဖ လ ဝိ သ ရ နဲ. Phal Nibbattiyan. Flabeth The grammar of the fruit. နိ တိ၊ Dha 162-4.] (1) Divided; It is destroyed. It will be destroyed. (3) (a) it bears fruit; (b) it completes; (4) It thunders. (5) It explodes. Destroyed.

S: phalati：[phal] 破れる，裂ける； 熟す，結実す=phallati．pp．phalita，phulla； caus．phāleti 裂けしむ，破る，裂く．
D: Phalati，（phal + a），结（果），爆裂开，分裂。 【过】 phali。【过分】 phalita。 【独】 phalitvā。 【现分】 phalanta。（p234）
F: Phalati，（phal +a），1．分裂（to split，burst open）。2．结（果），爆裂开（to become ripe，to ripen）。【过】phali。【过分】phalita，phulla。【独】phalitvā。【现分】phalanta。【使】phāleti ，phāṭeti。

phalati： phalati（kri）
ဖလတိ（ကြိ）
[phala+a+ti．phalavisaraṇe．phala nibbattiyaṃ．phala bhede．phala abyattasadde．nīti，dhā．162-4．]
[ဖလ+အ+တိ။ ဖလဝိသရဏေ။ ဖလ နိဗ္ဗတ္တိယံ။ ဖလ ဘေဒေ။ ဖလ အဗျတ္တသဒေ္ဒ။ နီတိ၊ ဓာ။ ၁၆၂-၄။]
C: phalati：[phal + a] bears fruit； bursts open； splits．
P: Phalati，[phal to split，break open=*sphal or *sphaṭ，cp．phāṭeti．On etym．see also Lüders，K．Z．XLII，198 sq．] 1．to split，burst open （intrs．） A．I，77 （asaniyā phalantiyā）； usually in phrase “muddhā sattadhā phaleyya，” as a formula of threat or warning “your （or my） head shall split into 7 pieces，” e．g．D．I，95； S．I，50； Sn．983； J．I，54； IV，320 （me）； V，92 （=bhijjetha C．）； Miln．157 （satadhā for satta°）； DhA．I，41 （m．te phalatu s．）； VvA．68； whereas a similar phrase in Sn．988 sq．has adhipāteti （for *adhiphāṭeti=phalati）．-- Caus．phāleti （& phāṭeti）．-- pp．phalita & phulla．-- 2．to become ripe，to ripen Vin．II，108； J．III，251； PvA．185．（Page 477）
I: phalati：To split asunder，break open，burst； to bear fruit
U: PHALATI：（phal+a） có trái，trổ trái，nứt nở ra [aor] --phali [pp] --phalita [abs] --phalitvā [prp] phalanta

phalati：ဖလတိ （√ဖလ်）
ကွဲ၏။ ပြီးစီး၏။
သတ္တဓာ ဖလေယျ၊ ခုနစ်စိတ်ကွဲရာ၏။ အသနိယာ ဖလန္တိယာ၊ မိုးကြိုးသည် ထစ်လတ်သော်။

[ S. phalati], 1. splits; bursts open; Vin I 203, 31 (añjanī ~ati, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nipatati); M I 237, 28 (hadayaṃ pi nāma ~issati); S I 50, 33* (sattadhā me ~e muddhā); 107, 3* (nabhaṃ ~eyya paṭhavī caleyya, Be, Ce, Ee paṭhaviṃ); Sn 983 (tuyhaṃ muddhā ~atu sattadhā); Pv 27:27 (pādā dukkhā ~anti no); Ja IV 320, 2* (musā me bhaṇamānāya muddhā ~atu sattadhā); VI 560, 21´ (hadayaṃ ca ~ati); Sp 755, 29 (ātapena sukkhakaddamo ~ati); Sadd 434, 15 (phala visaraṇe: … ~ati); 436, 8 (phala bhede: ~ati); — 2. bursts out; crashes (of thunder and lightning); Sp 64, 24 (asaniyo ~anti); Mhv 12:13 (~antāsaniyo vijjū niccharanti); Sadd 436, 10 (phala avyattasadde: asani ~ati); — part.pr. phalanta, mf (~antī) n. , D II 131, 10 (asaniyā ~antiyā; Sv 569, 20 : bhijjamānāya viya mahāravaṃ ravantiyā); A I 77, 19 (asaniyā ~antiyā; Mp II 150, 25 : saddaṃ karontiyā); Ap 105, 24 ; Sp 443, 10 (~antiyā bhūmiyā); — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) pr. 3 sg. phāleti , ~ayati ( sometimes (in Ee) written phāḷeti) [ cf BHS sphālayati, sphāleti, Pkt phāḍei], splits; splits open; bursts; Vin I 239, 22 (kaṭṭhāni ~enti); IV 316, 33 (~ehī ti āṇāpeti); D III 203, 23 (amanussā sattadhā pi ’ssa muddhaṃ ~eyyuṃ); A I 204, 29 (taṃ māluvālataṃ … khaṇḍakhaṇḍikaṃ chetvā ~eyya); Sn p. 32, 3 (cittaṃ vā te khipissāmi hadayaṃ vā te ~essāmi, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee phāḷessāmi); Ja III 146, 27* (uttamaṅgaṃ na hi ~ayāmi); Ap 24, 5 (kadaliṃ chetvā ~aye); — phāleyya in Ee at Dhp-a I 17, 20 and 134, 16 is wr for phaleyya ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — part.pr. ( a ) phālenta, mf (~entī) n. , Ja IV 141, 18 (hadayaṃ ~ento viya); Vism 379, 17 (~entī); ( b ) phālayanta, mfn. , Samantak 317; ( c ) phālayamāna, mfn. , Ja II 424, 28 (sā macchassa kucchiṃ ~ayamānā); Vism 593, 9 ; — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) phālesi, D II 341, 3 ; Ps III 345, 2 (ten’ eva asinā attano udaraṃ ~esi, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee phāḷesi); Mp I 307, 19 ; Ap-a 124, 16 ; ( b ) aphālesi, Ja VI 152, 5* (mā me hadayaṃ dukkhaṃ aphālesi); — absol. phāletvā, A I 204, 29 ; Ja II 88, 24 (paṭhaviṃ ~etvā); V 212, 13 (vatthaṃ dvidhā ~etvā); Vism 62, 28 (etesu aññataraṃ cīvaraṃ gahetvā ~etvā); Mhv 37:144; — neg. aphāletvā, Ps IV 191, 9 = Mp I 307, 12 ; — pass. pr. 3 sg. phālī̆yati, Vin I 31, 10 (~iyantu Kassapa kaṭṭhānī ti); 31, 14 (kaṭṭhāni pi ~iyissanti); Ps IV 237, 17 (khuradhārāhi ~iyati, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~īyati); — part.pr. phāliyamāna, mfn. , Th-a II 88, 12 ; — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) phāliyittha, Spk III 201, 3 (hadayamaṃsaṃ ~iyittha, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pati); 3 pl. phāliyiṃsu, Vin I 31, 12 ; — pp ( a ) phālita, mfn. , 1. split (open); burst; Vin I 186, 37 (pādā me āvuso ~itā ti); IV 316, 33 ; Sp 847, 30 (satthakena ucchu-ādīsu ~itesu); Ps IV 53, 2 (udaraṃ ~itaṃ); Spk II 282, 2 (ñāṇena avijjājālaṃ ~itaṃ); Nidd-a I 249, 16 (dantā ~itā); — 2. expanded, opened; Ja III 320, 26´ ([padumaṃ] suriyena ~itaṃ vikasitan ti); — see also phulla; — caus. ( b ) pr. 3 sg. phālāpeti , Vin IV 317, 3 ([gaṇḍaṃ] bhedāpeti vā ~eti vā); Mil 157, 26 (pharasunā ~eyya satadhā vā sahassadhā vā ti); Sv 215, 11 (savaḍḍhikaṃ iṇaṃ niyyādetvā paṇṇaṃ ~eyya, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee phalāpeyya) = Ps II 320, 6 ; Cp-a 308, 27 (jālaṃ ~eti); — absol. phālāpetvā, Ja III 121, 25 (dakkhiṇajannuṃ satthena ~etvā, Be, Ee so; Ce, Se phāletvā); Sv 134, 10 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee phalāpetvā).
